summary: Fixed both defects in M.list_extensions: readdir now filters dot-prefixed directories, and the invalid-manifest warning uses vim.notify_once for dedup. Two-line diff plus a new isolated regression spec; both defects verified behaviorally in headless Neovim.

artifacts.summary: Dot-prefix readdir filter and vim.notify_once dedup in M.list_extensions
New isolated regression spec: dot-skip, warn-once, valid-extension-still-returned

completion_data.completion_summary: Hardened extension discovery against stray directories: M.list_extensions now skips dot-prefixed entries during the readdir scan and dedups the invalid-manifest warning via vim.notify_once, eliminating the ~120 repeated warnings from a single stray directory across the function's 12+ call sites. Added an isolated regression spec covering both behaviors plus a non-over-matching guard.
